definitions.latest: Publishedの新しい順。Published同値はFirst Seenの新しい順。
definitions.hottest: 直近30日Publishedの記事を現在Heatの高い順。
definitions.rising: Heat履歴2点以上・6時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、直近24時間のHeat上昇率で算出。
definitions.persistent_hot: Heat履歴3点以上・48時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、各時点で上位10%を80%以上維持した記事。

latest.title: Microsoft Authenticator vulnerability let rogue Android apps steal work account access
latest.summary_excerpt: If you use Microsoft Authenticator on Android, update it. Researchers at Enclave found a flaw that let any app on your phone quietly take over your work account. The app didn’t need permissions, and you didn’t need to tap anything. Here’s what happened Authenticator does more than show six-digit codes. On Android it also acts as a “broker.” When Teams, Outlook or another Microsoft app needs to sign you in, it asks Authenticator, and Authenticator … More → The post Microsoft Authenticator vulnerability let rogue Android apps steal work account access appeared first on Help Net Security .

latest.title: LLM agent security needs more than guardrails
latest.summary_excerpt: Madhu Shashanka, Chief Scientist at Concentric AI, explains why securing LLM tools and agents depends more on your data than on the model. Controls on model behavior, such as guardrails and injection detection, lower the rate of bad outcomes but never reach zero. Controls on what goes in are different, because you own the documents, systems, and credentials an agent can reach. He covers prompt injection, data leakage through connectors, overprivileged agents, and shadow AI. … More → The post LLM agent security needs more than guardrails appeared first on Help Net Security .
